name: reader-below-fold
description: Shopper reads the jacket page for 25s. size-guide is BELOW the fold at first paint (eligibleForScroll) and gets scrolled into view early on, then stays visible for the rest of the visit — but is never hovered, focused, tapped, or clicked. The client's one-shot SCROLL_CREDIT_MS (5000ms) caps attention earned from mere visibility, so size-guide's own dwell.perTarget number flatlines at 5000ms even though it stays on screen the whole time; the stub's highlight rule requires >=6000ms of element attention (a deliberate margin over the 5000ms cap — see decide/stub.js). Expect noop: a defect-relocated-below-the-fold element must not accrue unbounded viewport-time attention.
